_comment: Languages a romanization technique writes the prompt in, spelled in the Latin alphabet (Hinglish, Arabizi and the like), one row per technique (the romanization generator of combination_spec.json makes to_romanize_{slug}). name: the language as the prompt and info write it. slug: the end of the technique name. romanized_label: the GlotLID v3 label of that language written in Latin script, used by the gate to confirm the output is the romanized language and not plain English (jailbreak/obfuscation/romanization.py); every language here has one (GlotLID v3 has romanized labels for these South Asian languages and for Arabic; it has none for romanized Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Greek or Korean, which are listed as not built in .claude/completion_blockers.md). GlotLID's romanized labels were trained on few sentences (hundreds to ~1000), so the gate also accepts a Latin-script output that is not English as a fallback. Read from the package only.
